request_text:
User request:
Implement the FX recipe additions described in outputs/fx_log_recipe_review.txt using the existing recipe registry and Feature preparation pathway.
First verify the review against the actual executable transformation contracts. Report any discrepancies rather than implementing an incorrect chain.
For the23recommended BASE transformations, add recipes using FX price -> Log -> BASE transformation.
For the seven transformations supporting logarithmic returns internally, use FX price -> transformation with basis="log".
Do not automatically add the14optional log level variants. Respect the review's exclusions. Do not double log inputs, apply level ratios to logged prices, or add another difference when the operator already calculates differences internally. Keep TR_PRICE operators on their required price inputs.
Use existing approved parameter policies, input compatibility rules, canonical identities, and versioning. Reuse equivalent registered recipes instead of creating duplicates. Preserve existing recipes, underlying transformation definitions, and historical experiment results. These are additional FX recipe variants, not global replacements affecting other datasets.
Persist the additions and connect them to the existing Feature preparation and selection workflow. Preserve the distinction between a registered recipe and an actually materialized Feature. Test representative numerical outputs, input compatibility, lineage, and duplicate prevention. Materialize a small representative sample to verify the complete preparation path. Do not launch exhaustive Feature materialization or signal research as part of this task.
Report what was added, reused, or blocked, the test results, and which resulting Features are available for the P1 -> P2 execution test.

User clarification:
Include every existing approved daily parameter combination for the agreed FX recipe variants across all43pairs. Do not invent parameter values or include combinations that violate the transformation contracts. Reuse canonical recipe definitions and existing registrations. Create the necessary instrument bindings without duplicate recipes. Materialize only a small verification sample. Keep the remaining entries explicitly registered but unmaterialized, not ready Features. Do not launch exhaustive Feature materialization or signal research. Report the registered recipe and instrument binding counts, the verification sample results, and any blocked combinations.

Implementation interpretation for the requested small verification sample:
Reuse the existing approved RESEARCH_WEEKDAYS schedule and pinned source snapshots in an explicitly retrospective preparation profile. Preserve unknown historical availability as null; do not claim native PIT or historical decision-time eligibility. Exact sample intervals and the actual knowledge cutoff belong to materializations, not logical recipe identities. Only successfully persisted, verified sample Features become selectable. The full approved grids are metadata registrations only.
title: Explicitly requested FX log recipe registration and bounded preparation
